ko: 나 이제 주님의 새 생명 얻은 몸
en: Lately the life of Christ burst out alive in me!
Old things have passed away, even myself is new

ko: 그 생명 내 맘에 강 같이 흐르고
그 사랑 내게서 해 같이 빛난다
en: His life floods through me, like rivers towards the sea, His love shines on me like sun shining on the dew
Life hid in Him makes my gladness of heart
increase, I set no price on what pleased me in other days

ko: 주 안에 감추인 새 생명 얻으니
en: With Christ I'll savor life Unending every day
Now and forever I'll walk with Him all the way
With Christ I'll savor life Unending every day
Now and forever I'll walk with Him all the way
Life hid in Him makes my gladness of heart
increase, I set no price on what pleased me in other days
Hill, stream and woodland and all that I see is new, Sinner and foeman are turned into friends I know

ko: 새 생명 얻은 자 영생을 맛보니
en: This is eternal life tasted before it's due, Life with the Lord is a new heaven here below
Life hid in Him makes my gladness of heart
increase, I set no price on what pleased me in other days
Rough though and long His way, All set about with strife, With hymns I'll follow on exuberant with praise
I'll be with Christ my Lord unto eternal life,
Daily I'll walk with Him beyond the length of days
Life hid in Him makes my gladness of heart
increase, I set no price on what pleased me in other days
